*   **Morton Works:** Quote 145 (> 65). **Fail**.
*   **Dovwell Cooperative:** Quote 80 (> 65). **Fail**.
*   **Zelnick Traders:** Quote 20 ($\le$ 65), Delivery 17 days (> 10). **Fail**.
*   **Zelford Outfitters:** Quote 140 (> 65). **Fail**.

Only Ulmworth Works meets all criteria.
